future_milestone_intent: Run a bounded quality evaluation of the combined sidecar architecture before any implementation/adoption decision.

corpus_classes.purpose: baseline scholarly PDF with text layer and common section/reference structure
stress reading order, page indexing, references, and large-document runtime
evaluate table detection, cell structure, caption linkage, and coordinate anchors
evaluate layout blocks, figures, captions, and multi-column reading order
separate OCR capability from normal text-layer extraction and require typed blocker if unsupported

source_locality_controls: All inputs must be repo-local or staged under a documented artifact root with sha256, byte size, and source provenance.
Default execution mode is no-network; any network requirement must become a typed blocker or explicit preflight finding, not an implicit fetch.
Model/backend caches must be inventoried before parser execution; missing cache cannot silently download during quality gate.
No API keys are required for the planned parser-quality probe; quant-mind runtime remains excluded.
s05_validation_gate_inputs: EvidencePath source-span and coordinate anchoring tests
review packet completion and graph-readiness review post-check
no-write import rehearsal with all graph/import flags false
